en.headline: Inaugural Asia Music Event opens two-day electronic music conference at Soho House
en.dek: The industry gathering at Soho House Hong Kong runs 26 and 27 November with more than 50 sessions and a closing party featuring international techno artists.
body: The inaugural Asia Music Event opens today at Soho House Hong Kong, bringing together electronic music industry professionals from across Asia and beyond for a two-day conference.

Organisers said the event includes more than 50 programme sessions with over 100 speakers and representatives from more than 200 companies. Topics cover artist booking and touring, festivals and venues, platforms and fan culture, and the growth of electronic music markets in Asia. Speakers include figures associated with events such as Tomorrowland and Amsterdam Dance Event.

The conference runs on 26 and 27 November. An official closing party is scheduled for the evening of 27 November, featuring Belgian techno duo Joyhauser and Australian-born, Berlin-based artist Juliet Fox, along with the winner of an associated DJ contest. The organisers described the gathering as a platform for cross-market collaboration in the electronic music sector.

Tickets for conference access and an all-access option that includes the closing party were available through the event's official channels. The programme includes panels, workshops and networking sessions at the Sheung Wan venue.

zh.headline: 首屆亞洲音樂活動今日於蘇豪會展開電子音樂業界會議
zh.dek: 為期兩日的會議於蘇豪會香港舉行，設逾50場環節，並於27日晚舉辦閉幕派對，邀請國際techno藝人演出。
body: 首屆亞洲音樂活動（Asia Music Event）今日於蘇豪會香港開幕，匯聚來自亞洲及國際的電子音樂業界人士，舉行兩日會議。
主辦方表示，活動設逾50場節目環節，有逾100名講者及200多間公司代表參與。議題涵蓋藝人預訂與巡演、音樂節與場地、平台與粉絲文化，以及亞洲電子音樂市場發展。講者包括與Tomorrowland及阿姆斯特丹舞曲活動相關人士。
會議於11月26及27日舉行。官方閉幕派對定於27日晚上，由比利時techno組合Joyhauser及澳洲出生、現居柏林的Juliet Fox演出，並有相關DJ比賽優勝者參與。主辦方形容活動為促進電子音樂界跨市場合作的平台。
會議入場及包括閉幕派對的全程通行證可透過活動官方渠道購買。節目包括討論會、工作坊及交流環節，場地位於上環蘇豪會。
